evidence.title: Later productivity estimates face participation and timing bias
evidence.observation: METR reports that later study participation, task selection, and concurrent-agent time measurement make its updated productivity estimate unreliable.

source_locations.SRC-004: Opening findings; selection issues; Details of the productivity study

evidence.limitations: The authors consider greater speedup plausible but say their data weakly identifies its size. This is not a clean reversal of the earlier randomized result.
evidence.open_questions: How should AI-driven changes in who and what can be measured be described without forcing a new term?
